title: fix(pm): judge the --land dogfood gate only in repositories that carry the battery
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X1qGnTYLQs3EtmtCmjrcfCe)_
Fixes #35959
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感:这是车队内部的落地工具,只改变云仓库带收窄声明的拉取请求能否由席位正常落地。
- 属于车队落地工具链:替云仓库的席位解决「安全收窄类拉取请求被狗粮门禁永久拒绝、只能等人手合并」的问题。
- 出错时最坏是某个没有狗粮测试的仓库被放行;主仓库仍按原规则拒绝,改动可直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

`scripts/pm/label-write.mjs --land` judged its dogfood battery gate on every pull with a `!` title or a `(narrowing)` arm, whatever the repository. Only objectstack-ai/objectstack carries the `@objectstack/dogfood` battery and the queue's dogfood shards, so a cloud pull's os-dev report can only say `n/a`, and the gate refused it for good (measured on objectstack-ai/cloud#4405 by the card).

- New `LAND_DOGFOOD_BATTERY_REPOS` (today `objectstack-ai/objectstack` only), next to the gate's other constants, and a pure `repoCarriesDogfoodBattery(repo)`.
- `landDogfoodGate` returns `{ judged: false, noBattery: true }` with zero reads for an `owner/name` outside that list; the fold prints `② dogfood gate ✓ — not judged: REPO has no dogfood battery (only objectstack-ai/objectstack carries one)`.
- Fail-closed for objectstack is kept: a listed repo (any case) is judged exactly as before, and a `--repo` value that does not read as `owner/name` is judged too.
- The gate's header gains a `repo` row saying the above.

Which repos carry a battery (read at the time of this PR, via the contents API on default branches): objectstack — 10 of 33 workflows name dogfood (ci.yml 96 hits); hotcrm — 0 of 14; gallery — 0 of 1; cloud, objectui, objectos, mobile — NOT MEASURED (this session has no read access to them; the card's own measurement covers cloud).

## Tests

`node scripts/pm/label-write.mjs --self-test`: 339 cases pass across 18 batteries (was 334). The `--land` dogfood battery's pin goes 65 → 70 with five cases:

1. the pure predicate over objectstack (two spellings), cloud, hotcrm, gallery, and six non-`owner/name` values (judged);
2. the gate on a cloud pull with both markers: not judged, `noBattery`, zero `doCall` reads;
3. a cloud pull with a `(narrowing)` arm over an `n/a` report lands end to end (comment, pr_ready, automerge_enable; exit 0; no gate read; the ✓ line names the repo);
4. the same in cloud with a `!` title;
5. the same `(narrowing)` pull over an `n/a` report in objectstack still refuses: exit 2, zero sends, nothing written.

Ablation (committed first, via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restore proven by blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`): deleting the one guard line in `landDogfoodGate` reds exactly 3 of 339 cases (2, 3, 4 above), each cloud end-to-end case refusing with `why: the battery was not run`.

## Acceptance notes

- A repository that gains a dogfood battery has to join `LAND_DOGFOOD_BATTERY_REPOS` in the same pull that adds it; nothing reads its workflows to find out on its own.

## Verification

Read first: `landDogfoodGate`'s first line (the repo guard) and `repoCarriesDogfoodBattery` (the fail-closed answer for an unreadable repo); then the fold's ✓ line branch.

Two-minute check: `node scripts/pm/label-write.mjs --self-test` prints `✓ label-write self-test: 339 cases pass across 18 batteries`.
